description: This file defines an interface for a specialized string key-value hash map in C, including functions for creation, deletion, insertion, retrieval, iteration, serialization, and deserialization of string hash maps.

methods.name: stringHashMapCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a string hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapDeepClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing string hash map, copying all keys and values.

methods.name: stringHashMapDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the hash map and frees associated memory, optionally using a helper to free individual items.

methods.name: stringHashMapClear
methods.description: Removes all items from the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapPut
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the hash map; fails if key already exists.

methods.name: stringHashMapPutCopy
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the hash map, making copies of key and value.

methods.name: stringHashMapGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key without freeing it.

methods.name: stringHashMapContains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapDelete
methods.description: Removes a key and its value from the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorCreate
methods.description: Creates an iterator to traverse the hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the iterator and frees its resources.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorHasNext
methods.description: Checks if more items are available in the iterator.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorGetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next key-value pair from the iterator.

methods.name: stringHashMapIteratorDeleteCurrent
methods.description: Deletes the current item pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: stringHashMapJSONSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the hash map to a JSON string.

methods.name: stringHashMapJSONDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string to a hash map.

methods.name: stringHashMapToJSON
methods.description: Converts the hash map to a cJSON object.

methods.name: stringHashMapFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a hash map from a cJSON object.
